name: Brewpoint Rewards
tagline: A phone-first rewards app: stamp card, points and tiers, and Brew, a scripted helper that redeems with an ink stamp.
features: 10-stamp card with ink-pressed stamps, a points balance and Bean → Roast → Reserve tier progress
Scripted assistant (no AI API) with typing dots and rich reply cards for points, rewards and birthday offers
Redeem sheet with a QR-style code drawn deterministically in SVG
Stamp-burst redemption that updates the balance and the reward cards
